raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
The Qwen3.5 selector only generates aggregated serving commands and disables FP4 on GB200, so the new Dynamo deployment cannot be selected there. Add **Dynamo PD (GB200 NVFP4-V2)** to the existing selector, backed by the nine serving variants qualified in [InferenceX #2594](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/2594).

The selector generates copyable prefill, decode, and frontend commands with the selected variant's MTP depth, kernels, cache and scheduling limits, worker environment, request plane, and Dynamo package pair. TP16 decode exposes the four host ranks; discovery and decode-leader addresses are editable. The page explains the pinned container, checkpoint staging, fabric, etcd/NATS, and single or three-replica frontends with nginx. Worker commands now live in the selector instead of a duplicated shell case block.

These are short-context text-serving settings (`context-length=9236`) with FP8 KV cache and disabled radix cache. Long watchdogs and the final variant's `mem-fraction-static=0.94` remain visible tradeoffs. The page reports image build metadata and executed package fingerprints separately.

The rendered Mintlify selector was exercised across all nine variants and command roles, including clipboard output, TP16 ranks, address changes, and returning to aggregated serving. [Run 34389014274, attempt 1](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/34389014274), at InferenceX commit `c6331223dc1495f185373aef7ce2e1c759441367`, executed nine benchmarks and six GSM8K evals; strict exact match was 0.9666–0.9719 against a 0.94 threshold. That is existing harness qualification. The generated standalone Docker, service, and worker commands have **not** been independently executed on GB200.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

Qwen3.5 页面顶部的选择器此前只能生成聚合式服务命令，并且禁止在 GB200 上选择 FP4，因此无法从界面选择新增的 Dynamo 部署。本 PR 在现有选择器中加入 **Dynamo PD (GB200 NVFP4-V2)**，覆盖 [InferenceX #2594](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/2594) 已验证的九种服务配置。

选择器按所选配置生成可复制的 prefill、decode 和 frontend 命令，包含对应的 MTP 步数、内核、缓存和调度限制、worker 环境变量、请求传输方式以及 Dynamo 包版本。TP16 decode 提供四台主机的 rank 选择，并支持修改服务发现主机和 decode leader 地址。页面说明固定镜像版本、checkpoint 准备、网络设置、etcd/NATS，以及单 frontend 或通过 nginx 代理的三个 frontend 副本。worker 命令统一由选择器生成，移除了重复的 shell case 配置块。

这些配置面向短上下文文本服务（`context-length=9236`），使用 FP8 KV cache 并关闭 radix cache。较长 watchdog 超时和最终配置 `mem-fraction-static=0.94` 的取舍仍明确展示。页面分别记录镜像构建信息与实际运行的包指纹。

已在实际渲染的 Mintlify 页面中验证全部九种配置和三个命令角色，包括复制内容、TP16 rank、地址修改，以及切回聚合式服务。[Run 34389014274, attempt 1](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/34389014274) 对应 InferenceX 提交 `c6331223dc1495f185373aef7ce2e1c759441367`，实际执行了九个基准任务和六个 GSM8K 评测任务，严格精确匹配率为 0.9666–0.9719，高于 0.94 阈值。该证据来自原有测试框架；生成的独立 Docker、服务及 worker 启动命令尚未在 GB200 上单独执行。

</details>

nodes.body:
Hi @faradawn, thank you for all your help with the Qwen3.5 cookbook. Whenever you have a moment, could you please review this PR? It adds the "Dynamo PD (GB200 NVFP4-V2)" option to the Qwen3.5 selector, covering the nine variants qualified in InferenceX #2594, plus the matching section 3.3. I'd especially appreciate your eyes on the selector wiring, the Dynamo and fabric prerequisites, and the tradeoff notes.

One small request: the `call-gate / pr-gate` check is failing only because the PR is missing the `run-ci` label (it needs a maintainer to apply it). Since this is a docs-only change, could you or another maintainer add it when convenient, so CI can run? InferenceX #2594 can only merge once this lands. Thanks again!
Is this necessary to link the specific SA runs?
Seems a bit long for me. What does @nvpohanh think? Approving to unblock

@@ -5,6 +5,7 @@ metatags: --- import { Qwen35Deployment } from '/src/snippets/autoregressive/qwen35-deployment.jsx' +import { Qwen35DynamoCommands, qwen35DynamoRecipes } from '/src/snippets/autoregressive/qwen35-dynamo.jsx' ## 1. Model Introduction @@ -119,7 +120,7 @@ This section provides deployment configurations optimized for different hardware **Interactive Command Generator**: Use the configuration selector below to automatically generate the appropriate deployment command for your hardware platform and capabilities. - + ### 3.2 Configuration Tips @@ -232,6 +233,326 @@ This section provides deployment configurations optimized for different hardware - **Xeon CPU service configuration**: Please refer to the `Notes` part in the serving engine launching section in [the SGLang CPU server document](../../../docs/hardware-platforms/cpu_server#launch-of-the-serving-engine) to better understand how to configure the arguments, especially for TP (tensor parallel) and NUMA binding settings. +### 3.3 GB200 NVFP4-V2 with Dynamo prefill/decode disaggregation + +Use these recipes to serve text requests with +[`nvidia/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-NVFP4-V2`](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-NVFP4-V2) +on GB200 NVL72. Separate prefill and decode workers exchange KV and Mamba state through +Mooncake; a Dynamo frontend exposes the OpenAI API. The decode workers use the +checkpoint's embedded MTP head. These commands use `python3 -m dynamo.sglang`, the +Dynamo backend entrypoint, rather than the aggregated `sglang serve` entrypoint above. + +The settings below come from nine executed fixed-sequence deployment variants in +[InferenceX PR #2594](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/2594), at commit +`c6331223dc1495f185373aef7ce2e1c759441367`. +[Run 34389014274, attempt 1](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/34389014274) +executed nine benchmarks and six GSM8K evaluations. The harness executed these serving +settings; the standalone Docker and service commands below have not been independently +executed on GB200. Select **Dynamo PD (GB200 NVFP4-V2)** in the deployment selector above to generate +the prefill, decode, and frontend commands for any of the nine variants. + + +These are short-context settings: `--context-length 9236`, FP8 E4M3 KV cache, and disabled +radix cache. They are suitable starting points for the measured 8192-input/1024-output +text workload, not the model's full context window. FP8 KV can affect accuracy; validate +your workload before adopting it. The long heartbeat and watchdog settings retain the +tested configuration and delay detection of an unhealthy worker. The higher decode +memory fraction in the final variant leaves less headroom for other workloads. + + +#### Prerequisites and versions + +- Linux ARM64 GB200 hosts with four GPUs per host, a working NVL72 multi-node fabric, + NVIDIA Container Toolkit, RDMA devices, and host networking. The executed fingerprint + reported driver `580.126.20`, CUDA `13.0`, and Python `3.12.3`. +- Container: `lmsysorg/sglang:nightly-dev-cu13-20260709-074bb928`. Preserve this tag when + using the legacy `--mamba-scheduler-strategy` spelling below; do not substitute `latest`. + Image build metadata reports SGLang commit + `074bb928f09c6e044b98b93c7b8aef48032d013d`; the executed package fingerprint reports + `0.0.0.dev1+g2b3d9ad37` and editable source revision + `2b3d9ad3752eb7a20370c91a02beda7bcc073165`. These are separate provenance fields, + not evidence that a fresh pull was independently reproduced. +- The first eight variants retain the image's Dynamo packages. The executed fingerprint + reports both `ai-dynamo` and `ai-dynamo-runtime` as `1.3.0.dev20260708`, with TCP as the + request plane. Check the installed versions before serving. The final variant installs + both packages at `1.2.1` and uses NATS. Use the same pair and request plane on every + worker and frontend in a deployment. +- Stage the complete checkpoint and tokenizer on every worker host. The executed model + revision was `8f590eae8f10bf55d9a46f79ea0280bde435c9f8`. Use the checkpoint's embedded MTP + head and the framework's default loading of it; do not replace or quantize that head. +- Provide reachable etcd and NATS services. The examples use etcd client port `2379` and + NATS port `4222` with JetStream. Install ARM64 binaries compatible with the selected + Dynamo version; the worker fingerprints do not establish exact service-binary versions. + +On each worker host, choose writable host directories and download the checkpoint before +entering the serving container. `hf` is the Hugging Face CLI; authenticate with it if your +environment requires credentials. + +```bash Stage the checkpoint on each worker host +export MODEL_DIR=/srv/models/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-NVFP4-V2 +export CACHE_DIR=/var/tmp/qwen35-dynamo-cache +mkdir -p "$MODEL_DIR" "$CACHE_DIR/deepgemm-cache" "$CACHE_DIR/flashinfer-cache" +hf download nvidia/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-NVFP4-V2 \ + --revision 8f590eae8f10bf55d9a46f79ea0280bde435c9f8 \ + --local-dir "$MODEL_DIR" +docker run --rm -it --gpus all --network host --ipc host \ + --ulimit memlock=-1:-1 --device /dev/infiniband \ + --mount "type=bind,src=$MODEL_DIR,dst=/model,readonly" \ + --mount "type=bind,src=$CACHE_DIR,dst=/configs" \ + lmsysorg/sglang:nightly-dev-cu13-20260709-074bb928 bash +``` + +Use a separate container/shell on each worker host. For the TP2 variants expose two GPUs +per worker, for example `export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1` inside its container. All other +variants use four local GPUs. Each TP2 worker occupied its own physical host in the +executed recipes; packing several workers onto one host is a different layout. + + + +Only for `7p4d-dep4-dep4-c12288`, run this in each worker and frontend container: + +```bash Install the final variant's Dynamo pair +python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages --no-deps \ + --extra-index-url https://pypi.nvidia.com \ + ai-dynamo==1.2.1 ai-dynamo-runtime==1.2.1 +``` + +For every variant, inspect the package identity rather than inferring it from the image tag: + +```bash Inspect serving package versions +python3 - <<'PY' +from importlib.metadata import version +for name in ("sglang", "ai-dynamo", "ai-dynamo-runtime"): + print(name, version(name)) +PY +``` + +Install before launching processes. `--no-deps` matches the original staged-wheel install +and preserves the image's engine and shared dependency versions. The wheel pair is an official Dynamo dependency, +not a serving-engine patch. A different package combination needs fresh validation. + + + +#### Start discovery and transport services + +Run these commands on one infrastructure host, in separate terminals. Replace the example +IP with that host's reachable address. Use dedicated empty data directories; do not +delete data belonging to an existing service. This single-instance setup matches the +deployment layout and is not a highly available service configuration. + +```bash Start etcd on the infrastructure host +export INFRA_IP=192.0.2.10 +export ETCD_DATA_DIR=/var/tmp/qwen35-etcd +etcd --data-dir "$ETCD_DATA_DIR" \ + --listen-client-urls http://0.0.0.0:2379 \ + --advertise-client-urls "http://$INFRA_IP:2379" +``` + +```bash Start NATS with JetStream on the infrastructure host +export NATS_DATA_DIR=/var/tmp/qwen35-nats +nats-server -js -sd "$NATS_DATA_DIR" +``` + +On all workers and frontend shells, set the same reachable endpoints. TCP request-plane +variants still use NATS for events and etcd for discovery. + +```bash Set discovery endpoints in each serving shell +export ETCD_ENDPOINTS=http://192.0.2.10:2379 +export NATS_SERVER=nats://192.0.2.10:4222 +export DYN_SKIP_SGLANG_LOG_FORMATTING=1 +export DYN_LOG=info,dynamo_runtime::pipeline::network::ingress::push_handler=warn +``` + +Permit the discovery ports, the frontend API port, each worker's HTTP/system/NCCL and +prefill bootstrap ports, and fabric traffic between participating hosts. The service +and fabric addresses must resolve inside the containers. + +#### Worker environment and shared engine flags + +Run the following blocks in each worker container's Bash shell. Cache paths refer to the +writable `/configs` mount above. The original offline flags (`HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1` and +`TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1`) can be enabled after the complete checkpoint/tokenizer is +staged; they control file access rather than the engine's numerical behavior. + +The selector includes the shared worker environment in each generated prefill/decode +command, including MNNVL, cache paths, speculative V2, and the tested timeouts. + +Use the network device names configured for your NVL72 hosts. The executed launch also +set `NCCL_NET_GDR_C2C=1`, `NCCL_IB_SL=1`, `NCCL_IB_TIMEOUT=20`, and +`NVSHMEM_REMOTE_TRANSPORT=none`; copy these only on a matching fabric. Interface and HCA +names are site-specific. The following names are placeholders, not universal GB200 defaults: + +```bash Set the worker's fabric interfaces +export NCCL_NET_GDR_C2C=1 +export NCCL_IB_SL=1 +export NCCL_IB_TIMEOUT=20 +export NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=YOUR_IP_INTERFACE +export NCCL_IB_HCA=YOUR_COMMA_SEPARATED_HCA_NAMES +export UCX_NET_DEVICES=YOUR_COMMA_SEPARATED_HCA_PORTS_AND_IP_INTERFACE +export NVSHMEM_BOOTSTRAP_UID_SOCK_IFNAME=YOUR_IP_INTERFACE +export NVSHMEM_ENABLE_NIC_PE_MAPPING=1 +export NVSHMEM_HCA_PE_MAPPING=YOUR_HCA_PE_MAPPING +export NVSHMEM_REMOTE_TRANSPORT=none +``` + +The shared arguments retain mixed target quantization, FlashInfer CUTLASS FP4 GEMM, +TensorRT-LLM attention/MoE, FlashInfer linear-attention decode, FP8 KV cache, BF16 Mamba +state, disabled radix cache, and 64-token pages. Prefill and decode have separate cache, +batching, and MTP settings in the selector. + +The selector includes these shared arguments and the selected role's flags in one +copyable command. The aggregated parser, MTP, and Mamba-cache toggles are hidden +for Dynamo because the variant determines those settings. + +#### Choose a serving variant + +`P` and `D` count logical prefill/decode workers. A TP16/EP16 decode worker spans four +physical four-GPU hosts; four DEP4 decode workers occupy four hosts independently. +The `c` suffix identifies the originating workload point, not a frontend admission limit. +The generated commands include each worker's `--max-running-requests` value. + + + + + + + + + + + + + + +
VariantWorkers and parallelism (TP/EP/DP)Physical hostsDecode MTP steps
1p1d-tp4-tp4-c11P 4/1/1; 1D 4/1/123
1p1d-tp4-tp4-c41P 4/1/1; 1D 4/1/123
1p1d-tp4-tp4-c81P 4/1/1; 1D 4/1/123
3p5d-tp4-tp4-c1283P 4/1/1; 5D 4/1/183
2p2d-tp2-tp2-c5122P 2/1/1; 2D 2/1/143
2p3d-tp2-tp2-c7682P 2/1/1; 3D 2/1/153
7p1d-dep4-dep16-c51207P 4/4/4; 1D 16/16/16112
7p1d-dep4-dep16-c81927P 4/4/4; 1D 16/16/16112
7p4d-dep4-dep4-c122887P 4/4/4; 4D 4/4/4111
+ +Choose a variant in the deployment selector above, then choose **Prefill worker**, +**Decode worker**, or **Frontend**. The panel shows the worker/host counts, request +plane, Dynamo version, and MTP depth. For a TP16 decode worker, select rank 0–3 and +use the same reachable decode-leader address on all four hosts. + +The generated commands use `/model` and `/configs` inside the staged container. +Replace the example discovery and leader IPs with your deployment addresses. +For the final variant the command also installs the required Dynamo 1.2.1 pair. +The originating `c` suffix identifies a recipe; it does not set request concurrency. + +The DEP4 and DEP16 variants enable DP attention and DP LM-head alongside EP. The wide +DEP16 decode uses `flashinfer` all-to-all and `flashinfer_cutedsl` for target MoE, while +the speculative MoE path remains `flashinfer_trtllm` with no all-to-all. The final DEP4 +variant uses TensorRT-LLM MoE with no all-to-all, one MTP step, disabled FlashInfer +autotuning, and `SGLANG_NCCL_ALL_GATHER_IN_OVERLAP_SCHEDULER_SYNC_BATCH=1`. + +The final variant also enabled `NCCL_DEBUG=INFO`, `NCCL_DEBUG_SUBSYS=COLL`, and CUDA +coredumps in the harness. These are optional failure diagnostics, not numerical serving +settings. If enabled, point `CUDA_COREDUMP_FILE` at a writable diagnostic directory and +budget disk space. The generated commands retain all engine and transport settings without +requiring a harness-owned `/logs` path. + +#### Launch prefill and decode workers + +For a one-host worker, set its system and NCCL ports explicitly. The HTTP port may be the +same on different physical hosts. When placing several processes on one host, allocate +different HTTP, system, NCCL, and prefill-bootstrap ports. The original TP4 recipes supplied +bootstrap port `31000`; for the other recipes the launcher allocated it. The example uses +`31000` on each distinct prefill host and passes it once, avoiding duplicate flags. + +Run the generated prefill command on each prefill host and the decode command on +each decode host. The TP16 variants use seven one-host prefill workers and one decode +worker across four hosts. Each decode rank exposes four local GPUs. The selector +sets the rank's `--nnodes`, `--node-rank`, and `--dist-init-addr` explicitly. + +#### Launch the frontend and send requests + +Run a frontend in the same image and Dynamo package environment as its workers. It needs +the discovery endpoints and the selected request plane, but no model weights or GPU. +Wait for the expected worker registrations before sending requests. + +Choose **Frontend** in the selector and run its generated command. It exports the +selected request plane and discovery endpoints alongside the frontend invocation. + +The source recipes pass `--enforce-disagg`. The executed nightly frontend logs that this +flag is deprecated and ignored: it determines routing and readiness from registered +prefill/decode worker types. Do not rely on the flag alone to establish readiness. + +The wide DEP16 variants used three frontend replicas behind nginx. Start one on each of +three distinct hosts using the generated frontend command, with the same etcd/NATS endpoints +and request plane. +        "--mamba-track-interval 2048",
+        "--moe-runner-backend flashinfer_trtllm",
+        "--mem-fraction-static 0.8",
+        "--max-total-tokens 256000",
+        "--max-running-requests 128",
+        "--cuda-graph-max-bs 4",
+        "--chunked-prefill-size 262144",
+        "--max-prefill-tokens 131072",
+        "--scheduler-recv-interval 1",
+        "--stream-interval 50",
+        "--load-balance-method round_robin",
+        "--watchdog-timeout 1000000",
+        "--log-level info"
+      ],
+      "decodeFlags": [
+        "--tensor-parallel-size 4",
+        "--data-parallel-size 4",
+        "--expert-parallel-size 4",
+        "--enable-dp-attention",
+        "--enable-dp-lm-head",
+        "--mamba-track-interval 128",
+        "--moe-a2a-backend none",
+        "--moe-runner-backend flashinfer_trtllm",
+        "--speculative-moe-a2a-backend none",
+        "--speculative-moe-runner-backend flashinfer_trtllm",
+        "--disable-shared-experts-fusion",
+        "--speculative-algorithm NEXTN",
+        "--speculative-num-steps 1",
+        "--speculative-eagle-topk 1",
+        "--speculative-num-draft-tokens 2",
+        "--disable-flashinfer-autotune",
+        "--cuda-graph-max-bs 512",
+        "--mem-fraction-static 0.94",
+        "--max-total-tokens 2052736",
+        "--max-mamba-cache-size 1056",
+        "--max-running-requests 1056",
+        "--chunked-prefill-size 4096",
+        "--max-prefill-tokens 32768",
+        "--scheduler-recv-interval 1",
+        "--disaggregation-decode-polling-interval 8",
+        "--stream-interval 50",
+        "--soft-watchdog-timeout 240",
+        "--watchdog-timeout 300",
+        "--decode-log-interval 50"
+      ],
+      "prefillEnv": [],
+      "decodeEnv": [
+        "MC_TE_METRIC=true",
+        "SGLANG_MOE_NVFP4_DISPATCH=1",
+        "SGLANG_FLASHINFER_NUM_MAX_DISPATCH_TOKENS_PER_RANK=1024",
+        "SGLANG_NCCL_ALL_GATHER_IN_OVERLAP_SCHEDULER_SYNC_BATCH=1",
+        "SGLANG_DECODE_BOOTSTRAP_TIMEOUT=1000"
+      ]
+    }
+  ]
+};
+
+export const Qwen35DynamoCommands = ({ recipes, isDark }) => {
+  const [profileId, setProfileId] = useState(recipes.profiles[0].id);
+  const [role, setRole] = useState('prefill');
+  const [rank, setRank] = useState('0');
+  const [discoveryHost, setDiscoveryHost] = useState('192.0.2.10');
+  const [decodeLeader, setDecodeLeader] = useState('192.0.2.20');
+  const [copyState, setCopyState] = useState('');
+  const profile = recipes.profiles.find(item => item.id === profileId);
+  const isMultiNodeDecode = role === 'decode' && profile.decodeNodes > 1;
+  const addressesReady = discoveryHost.trim() && (!isMultiNodeDecode || decodeLeader.trim());
+  const shellQuote = value => "'" + value.replace(/'/g, "'\\''") + "'";
+
+  const generateCommand = () => {
+    if (!addressesReady) return '# Enter the discovery host and, for TP16 decode, the decode leader.';
+    const lines = [
+      `# ${profile.id} — ${role}; use image ${recipes.image}`,
+      `# Dynamo package pair: ${profile.dynamoVersion}`,
+    ];
+    if (profile.installDynamo) {
+      lines.push(
+        'python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages --no-deps \\',
+        '  --extra-index-url https://pypi.nvidia.com \\',
+        '  ai-dynamo==1.2.1 ai-dynamo-runtime==1.2.1',
+      );
+    }
+    lines.push(
+      `export ETCD_ENDPOINTS=${shellQuote(`http://${discoveryHost.trim()}:2379`)}`,
+      `export NATS_SERVER=${shellQuote(`nats://${discoveryHost.trim()}:4222`)}`,
+      `export DYN_REQUEST_PLANE=${profile.requestPlane}`,
+      'export DYN_SKIP_SGLANG_LOG_FORMATTING=1',
+      'export DYN_LOG=info,dynamo_runtime::pipeline::network::ingress::push_handler=warn',
+    );
+    if (role === 'frontend') {
+      lines.push(
+        `# Run on ${profile.frontends} distinct frontend host${profile.frontends > 1 ? 's; configure nginx as described below' : ''}.`,
+        'python3 -m dynamo.frontend --http-port=30000 --enforce-disagg',
+      );
+      return lines.join('\n');
+    }
+    const isPrefill = role === 'prefill';
+    const roleEnv = isPrefill ? profile.prefillEnv : profile.decodeEnv;
+    lines.push(
+      '# Run inside the staged worker container after configuring fabric interfaces below.',
+      `export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=${profile.gpusPerHost === 2 ? '0,1' : '0,1,2,3'}`,
+      ...recipes.commonEnv.map(value => `export ${value}`),
+      ...roleEnv.map(value => `export ${value}`),
+      `export DYN_SYSTEM_PORT=${isPrefill ? 7500 : 7501}`,
+    );
+    const flags = [
+      ...recipes.commonFlags,
+      ...(isPrefill ? profile.prefillFlags : profile.decodeFlags),
+      '--host 0.0.0.0',
+      '--port 6100',
+      `--nccl-port ${isPrefill ? 17500 : 17501}`,
+      `--request-plane ${profile.requestPlane}`,
+      `--disaggregation-mode ${role}`,
+    ];
+    if (isPrefill) flags.push('--disaggregation-bootstrap-port 31000');
+    if (isMultiNodeDecode) {
+      flags.push(
+        `--nnodes ${profile.decodeNodes}`,
+        `--node-rank ${rank}`,
+        `--dist-init-addr ${shellQuote(`${decodeLeader.trim()}:29500`)}`,
+      );
+    }
+    lines.push('python3 -m dynamo.sglang \\\n  ' + flags.join(' \\\n  '));
+    return lines.join('\n');
+  };
+
+  const command = generateCommand();
+  useEffect(() => { setCopyState(''); }, [command]);
+  const copyCommand = async () => {
+    try {
+      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(command);
+      setCopyState('Copied');
+    } catch {
+      setCopyState('Copy failed; select the command below to copy it.');
+    }
+  };
+  const card = {
+    padding: '10px 12px', border: `1px solid ${isDark ? '#374151' : '#e5e7eb'}`,
+    borderLeft: '3px solid #D45D44', borderRadius: '4px', background: isDark ? '#1f2937' : '#fff',
+    color: isDark ? '#e5e7eb' : 'inherit', fontSize: '13px',
+  };
+  const control = {
+    padding: '6px 8px', border: `1px solid ${isDark ? '#9ca3af' : '#d1d5db'}`,
+    borderRadius: '3px', background: isDark ? '#374151' : '#fff', color: 'inherit',
+    fontSize: '13px', maxWidth: '100%',
+  };
+  const mtpSteps = profile.decodeFlags.find(flag => flag.startsWith('--speculative-num-steps ')).split(' ')[1];
+
+  return (
+    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '4px' }}>
+      <p style={{ margin: '6px 0', fontSize: '13px' }}>
+        Use the pinned serving container after completing the{' '}
+        <a href="#3-3-gb200-nvfp4-v2-with-dynamo-prefill-decode-disaggregation" style={{ color: '#D45D44', textDecoration: 'underline' }}>checkpoint, service, and fabric setup below</a>.
+      </p>
+      <div style={card}>
+        <label style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center', gap: '12px' }}>
+          <strong style={{ minWidth: '140px' }}>Serving variant</strong>
+          <select aria-label="Serving variant" value={profileId} onChange={event => setProfileId(event.target.value)} style={{ ...control, flex: 1 }}>
+            {recipes.profiles.map(item => <option key={item.id} value={item.id}>{item.id}</option>)}
+          </select>
+        </label>
+        <p style={{ margin: '8px 0 0', lineHeight: '1.5' }}>
+          {profile.prefillWorkers} prefill + {profile.decodeWorkers} decode workers across {profile.hosts} physical hosts;
+          {' '}{profile.gpusPerHost} GPUs per host exposed to each worker.
+          {' '}Decode MTP: {mtpSteps} steps. Dynamo {profile.dynamoVersion}; {profile.requestPlane.toUpperCase()} requests.
+          {' '}{profile.frontends} frontend replica{profile.frontends > 1 ? 's behind nginx' : ''}.
+        </p>
+        <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0', opacity: 0.8 }}>
+          The c suffix identifies the source workload point; serving limits come from the selected recipe.
+        </p>
+      </div>
+      <div style={{ ...card, display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: '12px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
+        <strong style={{ minWidth: '140px' }}>Command role</strong>
+        {[
+          ['prefill', 'Prefill worker'], ['decode', 'Decode worker'], ['frontend', 'Frontend'],
+        ].map(([id, label]) => (
+          <button key={id} type="button" aria-pressed={role === id} onClick={() => setRole(id)}
+            style={{ ...control, cursor: 'pointer', ...(role === id ? { background: '#D45D44', color: 'white', borderColor: '#D45D44' } : {}) }}>
+            {label}
+          </button>
+        ))}
+      </div>
+      <div style={{ ...card, display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: '12px' }}>
+        <label>Discovery host{' '}
+          <input aria-label="Discovery host" value={discoveryHost} onChange={event => setDiscoveryHost(event.target.value)} style={control} />
+        </label>
+        {isMultiNodeDecode && <>
+          <label>Decode leader{' '}
+            <input aria-label="Decode leader" value={decodeLeader} onChange={event => setDecodeLeader(event.target.value)} style={control} />
+          </label>
+          <label>Decode rank{' '}
+            <select aria-label="Decode rank" value={rank} onChange={event => setRank(event.target.value)} style={control}>
+              {['0', '1', '2', '3'].map(value => <option key={value} value={value}>{value}</option>)}
+            </select>
+          </label>
+        </>}
+        <span style={{ width: '100%', opacity: 0.8 }}>Replace the example IPs with addresses reachable from every serving container.</span>
+      </div>
+      <div style={card}>
+        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: '8px', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
+          <strong>{role === 'frontend' ? 'Frontend' : role === 'prefill' ? 'Prefill worker' : 'Decode worker'} command</strong>
+          <button type="button" onClick={copyCommand} disabled={!addressesReady} style={{ ...control, marginLeft: 'auto', cursor: 'pointer' }}>Copy command</button>
+          <span role="status" aria-live="polite">{copyState}</span>
+        </div>
+        <pre aria-label="Generated Dynamo command" style={{
+          padding: '12px 16px', margin: 0, background: isDark ? '#111827' : '#f5f5f5',
+          borderRadius: '6px', fontFamily: "'Menlo', 'Monaco', 'Courier New', monospace",
+          fontSize: '12px', lineHeight: '1.5', whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap', overflow: 'auto', maxHeight: '520px',
+        }}>{command}</pre>
+      </div>
+    </div>
+  );
+};

issue_comments.body:
Hi @faradawn, thank you for all your help with the Qwen3.5 cookbook. Whenever you have a moment, could you please review this PR? It adds the "Dynamo PD (GB200 NVFP4-V2)" option to the Qwen3.5 selector, covering the nine variants qualified in InferenceX #2594, plus the matching section 3.3. I'd especially appreciate your eyes on the selector wiring, the Dynamo and fabric prerequisites, and the tradeoff notes.

One small request: the `call-gate / pr-gate` check is failing only because the PR is missing the `run-ci` label (it needs a maintainer to apply it). Since this is a docs-only change, could you or another maintainer add it when convenient, so CI can run? InferenceX #2594 can only merge once this lands. Thanks again!
